_what_this_is: A one-use maintainer decision. It states who permitted what, at what cumulative spend, against what cap, and what it does NOT authorize. It deliberately asserts no derived identity: the timestamp, the committed base, the harness digest and both plan hashes are computed by scripts/autoinit/issue_phase_a_authorization.py, which refuses a grant that claims any of them. Consumed by exactly one issuance.
granted_by: Maintainer decision, 2026-08-21, at commit f331e49. GO for Phase-A Attempt 12 only. Attempt 11 passed Stage 0 and Stage 1 -- the first completed AutoInit beam search, 43 states over 4 levels, five leaves selected, with the existing COMPOSITE_STAGE1 recipe on Pareto front 4 and NOT selected -- and then lost the probe at Stage 2 to a tokenizer inferred from a weight-only checkpoint, and lost all five leaf checkpoints with the pod. Local storage was cleared to 22.25 GiB by reclaiming 14.9107 GiB of derived caches with no checkpoint deleted; the retained 23.09 GiB review set is closed and must not be revisited. No further canary, measurement, readiness or cleanup phase is to be added before this run.

fail_closed_instruction: On any failure: preserve the full traceback and the stage artifacts, fail closed, collect evidence through the supported path, obtain provider-confirmed teardown, and stop for review.
